title: Xact WebMCP Foundry: Intent to Governed Agent Execution

slides.title: Xact WebMCP Foundry
slides.narration: Welcome to the Xact WebMCP Foundry. This is the blueprint for transforming human intent into governed, deterministic agent capability.

slides.title: The Boss vs X-Nodes
slides.narration: Rule number one: Don't spend intelligence on work that doesn't require it. The Boss understands the conversation, while X-Nodes are deterministic units that own the real-world consequences.

slides.title: The Build Brief: Semantic Triage
slides.narration: The Build Brief triages intent into three distinct streams: Resolved requirements route directly to X-Nodes, genuine uncertainty goes to the Boss, and Commit Constraints enforce strict policy checks.

slides.title: Microsecond Execution
slides.narration: Known operations execute in microseconds with zero token overhead. With a nine microsecond mean latency and over one hundred and nine thousand decisions per second, known work never waits on model inference.

slides.title: Parallelize & Concentrate
slides.narration: Parallelize what is exact, and concentrate intelligence only where exactness ends. When semantic reasoning is genuinely necessary, Xact uses it. When it isn't, Xact eliminates the reasoning tax.

slides.title: Authority & Governance Lifecycle
slides.narration: Capability is knowing how; authority is being allowed to. Every action flows through four governed gates: Propose, Door, Ledger, and finally Commit.

slides.title: Proof & Verification
slides.narration: If it lights up, Xact actually did it. Execution alone is not proof. We enforce a strict foundational rule: No evidence, no claim. No authorization, no commit.

slides.title: Governed Learning
slides.narration: Governed learning steadily absorbs expensive reasoning into exact capability. Once a pattern is validated and activated, future problems move permanently to the fast, zero-token path.

slides.title: The Strategic Result
slides.narration: The LLM didn't get faster; Xact simply stopped needing it. By reducing reasoning load by eighty-six percent, what required intelligence yesterday executes exactly today.

slides.title: Nothing Here Is Prebuilt
slides.narration: These tools are built live as you ask. Some prompts are convenient starting points. A millisecond build can look prebuilt. It is not.

slides.title: Try a Business Tool Request
slides.narration: Try a custom business tool request. The Boss may ask for the bounds it needs. Xact decides whether that capability may become real.
